code:
PivotTable: Rows = CustomerID, Values = MAX(OrderDate)
  Filter: exclude OrderTotal <= 0

=SUMPRODUCT(
    (Orders[CustomerID]=A2) *
    (Orders[OrderTotal]>0) *
    (Orders[OrderDate]>=EDATE($G$1,-12)) *
    (Orders[OrderDate]<$G$1)
)
caption: Same math, Excel's own aggregation engine.

code:
=IF(ISBLANK(LastOrderLookup),"Never Purchased",
   IF($G$1-LastOrderLookup<=90,"Active",
      IF(AND($G$1-LastOrderLookup>90,
             PriorYearCount>=2),"Churned",
         "Not Yet Retained")))
caption: Identical ninety-day / two-purchase rule as SQL and DAX.
